objective: The Hooks Store, job 12: the proven lane (SPEC 1.46, decision 39) after the carry-overs. Carry-overs first. (h) Phantom scroll gap (3.2, decision 37): give every scroll container position: relative (.hc-scroll, .findings .list, .understood, .shelf, .marquee and any element with overflow auto or scroll) so the absolutely positioned .sr labels stop extending the sticky column's scroll range; a unit test that every overflow selector in styles.css also sets position; Playwright at 1920x1080 and 1366x768 with seven findings showing asserts the column's scrollHeight equals its last child's bottom plus the padding within 2 px, at load and after scrolling the column to its end. (i) The Builder goes fluid (3.2, decision 38): .builder-page.wrap takes max-width 1800px with padding-inline clamp(16px, 3vw, 48px) keeping the safe-area max() on each side; the .b2 grid keeps steps minmax(0, 1fr) and the card becomes clamp(420px, 28vw, 520px) from 1100 px up; rule rows, the shelf and fields fill their column; paragraph text keeps its 65ch measure; type sizes unchanged; the width sweep adds 1920x1080 and 2560x1440 asserting the content edges sit within the gutters up to 1800 px, no sideways scroll, the card inside the viewport. Then the job itself, SPEC 4.17 and 6.8. (1) Nearest match: when a draft has no exact proven match, matchProvenLaunch picks the proven launch of the same type (A, B or C) with the most block ids in common, ties to the newer launch, with at least one block in common besides token and own-token; the Builder line reads "Adapted from a proven launch: <name> (launch <n>, audited <date>): the swarm removes <blocks> and adds <blocks>"; the request sentence tells the swarm to start from that repository and commit, remove the named blocks and add the named blocks, then audit as a new hook; exact matches keep today's sentence. Unit tests for exact, nearest, tie and no-match, and that a words-only draft never matches. (2) Catalog and hook page marks: a launch in the proven index shows a PROVEN pill on its catalog card and hook page, with "Build one like this" preloading its blocks; the index is read exactly as today from evidence/proven-launches.json at the spec repository's raw URL (now updated by a scheduled script; the file's shape is unchanged, extra fields such as tokenAddress, deployerAddress, poolId and notes may be present and are ignored). (3) The wait line and the cost row read "Usually 30 to 90 minutes, sometimes up to 3 hours. From a proven launch, usually less." and, when a proven match exists, the card adds "This stack starts from audited code." (4) No instant lane, no factory, no free launch: the Builder offers exactly one launch, 0.5 IMD through the swarm; remove any copy that promised an instant lane. Tests: unit tests for (1) to (3); Playwright at 390x844, 1100x800 and 1920x1080 for a draft with a nearest match (the line, the request sentence, the sheet) and for a proven catalog card. Deliver source, dist/ and test results.
